TRANSMUTER-HALITE_BASH.title: Halite Bash
TRANSMUTER-HALITE_BASH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the target's [gold]Salt[/gold], then apply {Salt:diff()} [gold]Salt[/gold].
TRANSMUTER-CALCINATION.title: Calcination
TRANSMUTER-QUICK_PRIMER.title: Quick Primer
TRANSMUTER-SALT_WARD.title: Salt Ward
TRANSMUTER-FUME_CLOUD.title: Fume Cloud
TRANSMUTER-GLASS_VIAL.title: Glass Vial
TRANSMUTER-DISTILL.title: Distill
TRANSMUTER-DISTILL.description: {IfUpgraded:show:Triple|Double} a single [gold]Reagent[/gold] on an enemy, only if it has 1 [gold]Reagent[/gold] type.
TRANSMUTER-SPLASH_ACID.title: Splash Acid
TRANSMUTER-SPLASH_ACID.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the enemy has any [gold]Reagent[/gold], deal {Damage:diff()} damage again.
TRANSMUTER-HERMETIC_SEAL.title: Hermetic Seal
TRANSMUTER-CHAIN_DETONATION.title: Chain Detonation
TRANSMUTER-CHAIN_DETONATION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {Sulfur:diff()} [gold]Sulfur[/gold].
Whenever [gold]Detonate[/gold] triggers this turn, apply {ChainSulfur:diff()} [gold]Sulfur[/gold] to ALL other enemies.
TRANSMUTER-SUBLIMATE.title: Sublimate
TRANSMUTER-SUBLIMATE.description: Convert all stacks of one [gold]Reagent[/gold] on an enemy into another [gold]Reagent[/gold], then add {BonusStacks:diff()} stacks of it.
TRANSMUTER-QUICKSILVER_NEEDLE.title: Quicksilver Needle
TRANSMUTER-QUICKSILVER_NEEDLE.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice.
Apply {Mercury:diff()} [gold]Mercury[/gold] on each hit.
TRANSMUTER-LEAD_TO_GOLD.title: Lead to Gold
TRANSMUTER-LEAD_TO_GOLD.description:
Trigger a [gold]Reaction[/gold] on an enemy with 2+ stacks of a single [gold]Reagent[/gold] as if 1 [gold]Salt[/gold] was applied. If triggered, gain {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold].
Exhaust.
TRANSMUTER-VOLATILE_FLASK.title: Volatile Flask
TRANSMUTER-VOLATILE_FLASK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Apply {Mercury:diff()} [gold]Mercury[/gold] to ALL enemies.
TRANSMUTER-ATHANOR_FURNACE.title: Athanor Furnace
TRANSMUTER-ATHANOR_FURNACE.description: At the start of your turn, apply {Sulfur:diff()} [gold]Sulfur[/gold] to the enemy with the highest HP.
TRANSMUTER-RESIDUAL_PRECIPITATE.title: Residual Precipitate
TRANSMUTER-RESIDUAL_PRECIPITATE.descript: Whenever a [gold]Reaction[/gold] triggers on an enemy, reapply {Residue:diff()} stacks of the first [gold]Reagent[/gold] consumed.
TRANSMUTER-SYMPATHETIC_TINCTURE.title: Sympathetic Tincture
TRANSMUTER-SYMPATHETIC_TINCTURE.descript: For each unique debuff on the enemy, apply {Sulfur:diff()} [gold]Sulfur[/gold].
TRANSMUTER-CRUCIBLE_SHIELD.title: Crucible Shield
TRANSMUTER-CRUCIBLE_SHIELD.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Whenever you trigger a [gold]Reaction[/gold] this turn, gain {ReactionBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
TRANSMUTER-THE_MAGNUM_OPUS.title: The Magnum Opus
TRANSMUTER-THE_MAGNUM_OPUS.description: Apply [gold]Stabilize[/gold], then apply {Reagents:diff()} [gold]Salt[/gold], {Reagents:diff()} [gold]Sulfur[/gold], and {Reagents:diff()} [gold]Mercury[/gold], then immediately trigger [gold]Magnum Opus[/gold].
TRANSMUTER-PHILOSOPHERS_ENGINE.title: Philosopher's Engine
TRANSMUTER-UNIVERSAL_SOLVENT.title: Universal Solvent
TRANSMUTER-UNIVERSAL_SOLVENT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Remove all [gold]Artifact[/gold] and [gold]Block[/gold] from ALL enemies, then apply {Salt:diff()} [gold]Salt[/gold] and {Mercury:diff()} [gold]Mercury[/gold] to ALL enemies.
TRANSMUTER-NIGREDO_ALBEDO_RUBEDO.title: Nigredo, Albedo, Rubedo
TRANSMUTER-NIGREDO_ALBEDO_RUBEDO.descrip: Choose 1 of 3 generated 0-cost cards to add to your [gold]Hand[/gold]: [gold]Nigredo[/gold], [gold]Albedo[/gold], or [gold]Rubedo[/gold].
TRANSMUTER-NIGREDO_ALBEDO_RUBEDO.selecti: Choose a Reagent tincture to add to your Hand.
TRANSMUTER-EMERALD_TABLET.title: Emerald Tablet
TRANSMUTER-EMERALD_TABLET.description: Whenever you apply a [gold]Reagent[/gold], apply +{BonusReagent:diff()} additional stack{BonusReagent:plural:|s}.
TRANSMUTER-NIGREDO_TOKEN.title: Nigredo
TRANSMUTER-ALBEDO_TOKEN.title: Albedo
TRANSMUTER-RUBEDO_TOKEN.title: Rubedo
